task.text:
[0] Worms were grown on 6-cm RNAi plate (NGM agar + 1 mM IPTG, 100 μg/ml ampicillin, and 5 μg/ml tetracycline).

[1] Authors showed that ATL-1 (ATR ortholog) regulates the mtDNA replication and its defect results in the mild oxidative stress response. L1 larvae stage was considered as t=0 for lifespan counting.

[2] Mice, homozygous by ATR mutation similar to Seckel syndrome, suffered elevated levels of replicative stress during embryogenesis and accelerated aging.

[3] Mice, homozygous by ATR mutation similar to Seckel syndrome, suffered elevated levels of replicative stress during embryogenesis and accelerated aging.

[4] Mice, homozygous by ATR mutation similar to Seckel syndrome, suffered elevated levels of replicative stress during embryogenesis and accelerated aging.

[5] Constitutive activation of ced-9 (BCL2L1 ortholog) extended the lifespan of worms.

[6] The pre-fertile period of adulthood was identified as t = 0.

[7] The pre-fertile period of adulthood was identified as t = 0.

[8] The data show that Drosophila lacking BLM have an elevated frequency of spontaneous genome rearrangements that increases with age. Loss of BLM significantly affects lifespan:mean lifespan of blm mutants was reduced more than 35% relative to wild type

[9] The data show that Drosophila lacking BLM have an elevated frequency of spontaneous genome rearrangements that increases with age. Loss of BLM significantly affects lifespan:mean lifespan of blm mutants was reduced more than 35% relative to wild type.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
